text: Handling deadlines well starts with good time management. When you receive a task, plan your schedule early and break the work into smaller steps. Prioritization is also important, so focus on the most urgent and important tasks first. If you realise you cannot finish everything, manage the scope by discussing with your manager or team what is essential. Communication is key throughout the process: tell people early if a deadline is at risk instead of waiting until the last moment. By planning carefully, focusing on priorities, adjusting the scope when necessary, and keeping others informed, you can handle deadlines with less stress and more success.
